channel.title: West Hawaii Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: Pentagon announces seventh US death in war with Iran
item.description: Another U.S. service member has died in the war with Iran, the Pentagon said Sunday, bringing the number of U.S. troops killed in the conflict to seven.

item.title: State Dept. said to order diplomats in Saudi Arabia to leave
item.description: WASHINGTON — American employees of the U.S. diplomatic mission in Saudi Arabia have been told to leave the country under mandatory departure orders issued by the State Department, according to current and former U.S. officials.

item.title: US authorities are investigating device thrown near Gracie Mansion
item.description: NEW YORK — Federal authorities will lead the investigation into the violence that broke out at a demonstration outside Gracie Mansion on Saturday, where a counterprotester threw a homemade bomb, three people with knowledge of the matter said Sunday.

item.title: Spring training roundup: Leo De Vries goes deep twice to lead A’s past Dodgers
item.description: Top prospect Leo De Vries homered twice, including a grand slam, to lift the Athletics’ split squad to an 11-7 spring training victory over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Sunday in Mesa, Ariz.

item.title: Lakers hold off Knicks for wire-to-wire win
item.description: Luke Doncic scored 35 points as the Los Angeles Lakers weathered some shaky moments in the fourth quarter, along with LeBron James sitting out, and recorded a wire-to-wire 110-97 victory over the visiting New York Knicks on Sunday.

item.title: BIIF golf: Warriors, ‘Riders tee off season at Waikoloa Village; Otani, Nakagawa win individual fields
item.description: WAIKOLOA — Big Island high school golf has officially teed off.

item.title: ‘A lack of transparency’: Residents blast county’s plan for transitional housing in Waiakea Uka
item.description: Neighbors of what could’ve been a county-owned, nonprofit-operated transitional house on a quiet Waiakea Uka Circle gave the County Council Finance Committee an earful last week.

item.title: Waimea event celebrates keiki climate case victory
item.description: Hawaii’s landmark youth climate victory will be the focus of a free community event at 5:30 p.m. Wednesday in Waimea.

item.title: Excess in the state’s special funds may help ease budget concerns
item.description: More than 200 special financial accounts at 20 state agencies are being examined by Hawaii lawmakers for excessive holdings that could help pay for general state expenses amid a challenging budgetary environment.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei as supreme leader
item.description: Iran named Mojtaba Khamenei, a son of the recently killed supreme leader, as his father’s successor, signaling the continuity of hard-line theocratic rule amid war with the United States and Israel.
